source.author: verg
source.text: Vestibulum ante ipsum, primisque in faucibus Orci Luctus et ultrices posuere cubilia Curae; pallentesque habitant Morbi, tristisque Senectus, et Metus, et malesuada Fames, ac turpis Egestas, terribiles visu formae: Letumque, Labosque; tum consanguineus Leti Sopor, et mala mentis Gaudia, mortiferumque adverso in limine Bellum, ferreique Eumenidum thalami, et Discordia demens, vipereum crinem vittis innexa cruentis.
source.text_original: Vestibulum ante ipsum, primisque in faucibus Orci / Luctus et ultrices posuere cubilia Curae; / pallentesque habitant Morbi, tristisque Senectus, / et Metus, et malesuada Fames, ac turpis Egestas, / terribiles visu formae: Letumque, Labosque; / tum consanguineus Leti Sopor, et mala mentis / Gaudia, mortiferumque adverso in limine Bellum, / ferreique Eumenidum thalami, et Discordia demens, / vipereum crinem vittis innexa cruentis.
source.text_english: In the vestibule before the very entrance, and in the first jaws of Orci, Grief and avenging Cares have their couches; pale Diseases dwell there, and sad Old Age, and Fear, and Hunger, the ill-advised, and loathsome Want, forms terrible to see: Death and Toil too; then Sleep, kinsman to Death, and evil Joys of the mind, and War bringing death on the threshold facing one, and the iron beds of the Eumenides, and mad Discord, her serpent hair bound with bloody fillets.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: tergeminam cum placat eram Stygiasque supremo obsecrat igne domos, iam iam exorabile retro carmen agens; neque enim ante leves niger avehit umbras portitor, et vinctae primis stant faucibus Orci.
reuse.text_original: tergeminam cum placat eram Stygiasque supremo / obsecrat igne domos, iam iam exorabile retro / carmen agens; neque enim ante leves niger avehit umbras / portitor, et vinctae primis stant faucibus Orci.
reuse.text_english: When he soothes the triple goddess and, with his final fire, implores the Stygian dwellings, now at last uttering a spell that can move to pity and lead back what was gone; for the dark ferryman does not yet carry off the light shades, and the chained ones stand fast at the first jaws of Orco.
